payload.title: Assembling the proxy database from the LiPDGraph
payload.description: This workflow demonstrates how to query the LiPDGraph database to assemble a proxy database for data assimilation in climate research. It involves retrieving datasets from the PAGES2k, iso2k, and CoralHydro2k compilations using SPARQL queries.
